gloss: back to back; inseparably linked (with danger or risk)

definitions.gloss: back to back; standing with backs touching
definitions.explanation: The physical position of two people standing or sitting with their backs against each other.

definitions.gloss: inseparably linked; two sides of the same coin
definitions.explanation: Figuratively describes two things that are closely connected, especially when something positive is inseparably linked with something negative or risky.

notes:
Literally "backs together" — from ⟦{背中|せなか}→背中：00810_senaka⟧ (back) + {合|あ}わせ (together). The literal sense describes the physical position, while the figurative sense expresses the idea that two contrasting things are inseparably connected, like two sides of the same coin.

USAGE:
As a physical description (sense 1), it is used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ as an adverb: {背中合|せなかあ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧. In the figurative sense (sense 2), it typically functions as a predicate: A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{背中合|せなかあ}わせだ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背中合|せなかあ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ — to stand back to back
- {背中合|せなかあ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧ — to sit back to back
- {背中合|せなかあ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ — an inseparable relationship
